Photo Exhibition - Down the memory lane
Saturday, 26 December 2015
5680 Hits
In addition to the events conducted as a part of Dr Sushila Nayar Birth Centenary year celebration, , a special photo gallery depicting some of the most defining moments from the life of Dr Sushila Nayar was launched on 26th December 2014. The exhibition had a collection of photographs from her personal life, her association with Mahatma Gandhi, her connection with political world and her relationship with MGIMS. These historical photographs, artistically showcased in the Sarojini Naidu Hall helped the younger generation understand the larger than life personality that Dr Sushila Nayar was gifted with.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
